name: Gnome
description: A gnome's energy and enthusiasm for living shines through every inch of their tiny body. Gnomes average about 3 feet tall and weigh 40 to 45 pounds, and their bright eyes and mischievous grins give away their good-natured love of life.

grants.name: Darkvision (60 ft)
grants.description: See in dim light within 60 ft. as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light (no color, only shades of gray).

grants.name: Gnome Cunning
grants.description: Advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

grants.name: Natural Illusionist
grants.description: Know the Minor Illusion cantrip. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

grants.name: Speak with Small Beasts
grants.description: Communicate simple ideas with Small or smaller beasts through sounds and gestures.

grants.name: Artificer's Lore
grants.description: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to magic items, alchemical objects, or technological devices, you're considered proficient and add double your proficiency bonus.

grants.name: Tinker
grants.description: Using tinker's tools, spend 1 hour and 10 gp of materials to construct a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 HP). It ceases to function after 24 hours unless you spend 1 hour repairing it, or when you dismantle it. Choose the device you build most often.

options.name: Clockwork Toy
options.description: A toy animal, monster, or person that moves randomly for 1 minute.

options.name: Fire Starter
options.description: Use the device to kindle a small fire.

options.name: Music Box
options.description: Plays a single song at a moderate volume when opened.
